Confirming for your autumn planning: Room 4 at the Willow Street annex seats 24 after the summer refit, and it is free on Monday and Thursday evenings from 18:00.
One more for your room list: Room 6 at Willow Street seats 26 and is free on Mondays between 18:00 and 21:00 all term.
Room 2 at Willow Street seats 18 and is free on Friday evenings; the smaller groups usually prefer it.
I can teach the Spanish B2 evening class on Mondays at 18:30 this autumn. We have 20 students enrolled so far.
Heads-up on capacity across the building: Room 2 at Willow Street will seat 24 once the new desks arrive in November, so it may suit bigger groups later in the term.
